symptom: describe printed a legacy Forms$DataGrid as one `-- Forms$DataGrid (grid1)  -- NOT re-executable` line, so its columns and search fields had no names in the output; `alter page … drop column14` passed check -p --references and failed at exec with `widget "column14" not found`
cause: findInWidgetChildren walked the grid's ControlBar.Items but never its Columns (Forms$GridColumn) or DataSource.SearchBar.Items (Forms$*SearchField), although both carry a stored Name; parseRawWidget had no Forms$DataGrid case so describe never read them either
insight: Unlike DataGrid2 columns (derived names, #78), legacy grid columns and search fields are NAMED — the gap was only which lists the finder walks, so the existing drop/set-Caption paths work unchanged once they are reachable. An unauthorable widget can still be printed structurally if every line stays a comment: exec of the output then drops the grid (as before) instead of building something different. Gate the walk on $Type: a LayoutGrid row also has a `Columns` key. No fixture holds a legacy grid (pedapp/testapp grep for Forms$DataGrid is empty), so tests build Studio Pro-shaped BSON from the property names in modelsdk/gen/pages
